objects.name: Visible Focus
requirements: Focus ring visible on every route object.
Focus indication must not rely on motion alone.

objects.name: Comfortable Tap Targets
requirements: Route objects are at least 44px high.
Route objects have enough spacing to avoid accidental taps.

objects.name: Reduced Motion
requirements: All routes remain visible and usable without animation.

objects.name: Semantic Structure
objects.purpose: Preserve structure while hiding visible category headings.
requirements: The main identity has a single h1.
Route clusters use aria-label when visible headings are removed.

build_rules: Accessibility rules are not optional visual polish.
Screenshots do not replace keyboard and semantic checks.
